faqs.question: How do I get to Kudarikilu Island?
faqs.answer: Public ferry service operates weekly from Male (approximately 10 hours journey time).

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Kudarikilu Island?
faqs.answer: The best time to visit Kudarikilu Island is during the northeast monsoon season (December to April), which brings dry, sunny weather with lower humidity and calmer seas.
